newsitem.title: MEXICO: Earthquake felt in Mexico City, no damage visible.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake felt in Mexico City, no damage visible.

text.p: An earthquake rocked Mexico City on Tuesday afternoon, swaying buildings and causing alarm, but no damage was immediately visible.
The quake at around 3:22 p.m. (2122 GMT) was felt all over the city.
Radio and television channels broke into normal programming to report the quake.
Announcers said there was no visible damage in the capital, but there was no immediate word on possible damage elsewhere in the country or on where the quake's epicentre was.
Mexico City, in a geologically unstable area, was rocked on Jan. 11 by a powerful earthquake measuring 7.3 on the open-ended Richter scale.
No damage was caused in the capital but Arteaga, a small town in the western state of Michoacan, was seriously hit.
